title: Internet Memes, Micro-Satire, and Digital Subversion

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: The digital era has not killed the *pesti vicc*; it has turbocharged it into internet memes. Within minutes of a political speech or gaffe, satirical images and remix videos *vírusként terjednek* (go viral) across Hungarian cyberspace.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Digital micro-satire preserves the essential traits of historical urban irony: lightning speed, deadpan juxtaposition, and the community catharsis of laughing at pompous authority.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A digitális mémek mint a pesti vicc modern folytatása...
